serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Hi Big Daddy, I’m calling you to ask if I can drop by for a bit.
Big Daddy: Oh, right. Sorry little one, but today was rather stressful for me. 
Big Daddy: I require some healing time with non-prescribable medications, if you know what I mean.
You: Oh, right. I totally get it. I won’t bother you.
